context: Daichi visits Tatsuya's small country town for the first time.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: たつや、この町、小さいけど、いいなぁ。
lines.en: Tatsuya, this town—small as it is, I really like it.
lines.style: Warm, appreciative opening with Kansai lilt. Genuine delight in his voice—the kind that comes from noticing something good. Soft throughout, unpressured. Real affection threading beneath the friendliness.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: 町の中心、駅、すぐそこだ。
lines.en: The town center, the station—it's right there.
lines.style: Quiet, unhurried. Speaking from ground-level knowledge. Patient, grounded delivery. Gentle warmth in the steadiness. No rush to fill space.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: Everyone here knows everyone, don't they.
lines.style: Warm observation, almost tender. Kansai accent alive in the phrasing. Light admiration—he's noticing what matters about this place. Soft, appreciative.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: 昔から、皆、家族みたいだ。
lines.en: They've been like family here—always have been.
lines.style: Philosophical, sparing. Deep warmth underneath the few words. Rural composure audible. Speaking of something settled and true. Gentle weight to it.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 自然、すぐ近くにある、贅沢やん。
lines.en: Having nature right on your doorstep—that's real luxury.
lines.style: Genuine enthusiasm breaking through. Kansai warmth and brightness. Not performative—he means it. Voice brightens on the realization. Soft conviction.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.style: Quiet philosophy. Unhurried, measured. Not comparing—just observing the difference with calm certainty. Gentle and steady. The words feel considered.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 一緒に、また、ゆっくり来るわ。
lines.en: I'm coming back here with you again, taking our time.
lines.style: Warm promise. Kansai softness in the commitment. Closing note of genuine affection. Not rushed—settling into what he's said. Real intent beneath.
